note: Every instrument the demo drives. The generator places a node INS_<id> for each; the viewer reads the same file to animate it. 'field' names a column of a feed trace row; 'rule' is evaluated on the feed row (trace) or the latest decision (decision).

derived_fields.rods_mean: mean of the rods array (percent inserted), computed by the viewer

instruments.label: POWER CH A
instruments.what: Neutron power channel A, as the decider reads it, in percent of nominal.
instruments.range: 0 to 150 %, red above the 120 % power trip
instruments.modelled: chA of each feed row: the true power P with 1 % Gaussian noise, in the demo's toy reactor.

instruments.label: POWER CH B
instruments.what: Neutron power channel B, an independent reading of the same power.
instruments.range: 0 to 150 %, red above the 120 % power trip
instruments.modelled: chB of each feed row. A scenario can stick this channel at a wrong value; then it disagrees with channel A.

instruments.label: DEMAND
instruments.what: The power the crew has been told to hold, in percent of nominal.
instruments.modelled: setpoint of each feed row; scenarios change it at fixed ticks.

instruments.label: ORM
instruments.what: Operational reactivity margin: control-rod equivalents inserted in the core.
instruments.range: 0 to 30; the operating rule is a minimum of 15 (red below)
instruments.modelled: orm of each feed row: 30 rod-equivalents times the bank insertion fraction in the toy reactor.

instruments.label: RODS MEAN
instruments.what: Mean insertion of all 211 control rods, 0 % fully withdrawn to 100 % fully in.
instruments.modelled: The mean of the rods array of each feed row (the demo's 211 individual rod positions, in percent inserted).

instruments.label: DRUM LEVEL
instruments.what: Steam drum water level relative to its normal level.
instruments.range: -50 to +50 cm; the demo trips the reactor when the level is more than 45 cm out
instruments.modelled: level of each feed row, a lagged swell of the steam drum in the demo's plant model.

instruments.label: COOLANT FLOW
instruments.what: Coolant flow through the core in percent of nominal.
instruments.range: 0 to 150 %; below 55 % at power the demo trips
instruments.modelled: f of each feed row: first-order lag toward the commanded flow.

instruments.label: STEAM PRESS
instruments.what: Steam drum pressure.
instruments.modelled: p of each feed row, relaxing toward a value set by the heat load.

instruments.label: FUEL TEMP
instruments.what: Fuel temperature.
instruments.range: 200 to 1600 C; nominal 750, trip above 1200, damage above 1500
instruments.modelled: Tf of each feed row: a lagged function of heat load and coolant flow.

instruments.label: STEAM VOID
instruments.what: Steam void fraction in the coolant channels; more voids raise reactivity in this reactor type.
instruments.modelled: void of each feed row, from heat load and flow.

instruments.label: XENON-135
instruments.what: Xenon-135 poisoning index; 1.00 is the full-power equilibrium.
instruments.modelled: X of each feed row, from the iodine-135 to xenon-135 chain with burnout.

instruments.label: IODINE-135
instruments.what: Iodine-135 inventory index, the precursor of xenon.
instruments.modelled: I of each feed row.

instruments.label: REACTIVITY
instruments.what: Total reactivity in dollars; 0 is critical, 1 is prompt critical.
instruments.modelled: rho of each feed row, summed from rods, xenon, void, Doppler and the graphite tip.

instruments.label: TIP REACT
instruments.what: Reactivity added by the graphite tips of the rods in the first seconds of a shutdown from withdrawn rods.
instruments.modelled: tip of each feed row, zero unless a shutdown is running.

instruments.label: HAZARD
instruments.what: How close the plant is to its nearest limit; 1.0 is a limit being reached.
instruments.modelled: hazard of each feed row, the demo's own index (fuel temperature, pressure, margin and power against their limits).

instruments.label: MODEL RISK
instruments.what: The decision model's own expected risk score for the current state, from 1 lowest risk to 5 highest risk.
instruments.range: 1 to 5; dark when no model has answered
instruments.modelled: model_risk of each feed row: the expected value of the model's risk answer. A feed with no model leaves it null and the needle rests.

instruments.label: POWER
instruments.what: Strip recorder of true power and both channels.
instruments.modelled: P, chA, chB of the most recent feed rows.

instruments.label: FUEL T / PRESS
instruments.what: Strip recorder of fuel temperature (0 to 1600 C) and steam pressure (0 to 12 MPa), both drawn on a 0 to 100 scale.
instruments.modelled: Tf and p of the most recent feed rows.

instruments.label: ORM / ROD BANK
instruments.what: Strip recorder of the operational reactivity margin (0 to 30) and mean rod insertion (0 to 100 %), both on a 0 to 100 scale.
instruments.modelled: orm and the mean of rods of the most recent feed rows.

instruments.label: DECIDER
instruments.what: The decision display: the decision model's latest decision with the probability it gave each answer, what was applied after the interlocks, and the scenario events.
instruments.modelled: decisions[] of the feed: answers.<question>.scores with the model id, requested and applied action, source and the interlocks that fired. Nothing here is generated by the viewer.

instruments.label: ORM TERMINAL
instruments.what: The reactivity-margin computer terminal on the engineer's desk: the last printed margin and the true margin, in rod equivalents, against the operating minimum.
instruments.modelled: orm_printed (the slow printout) and orm (true) of the current feed row, and scram.

instruments.label: AZ-5 ACTIVE
instruments.text: emergency shutdown (AZ-5) is active
instruments.what: Lit while the emergency shutdown is running.

instruments.label: CORE DAMAGE
instruments.text: the toy core has been damaged (fuel temperature above 1500 C)
instruments.what: Lit when the toy reactor has reached its damage limit.

instruments.label: ABSTAINED
instruments.text: the decision model abstained and the fixed safety policy held
instruments.what: Lit when the decision model's best answer was under its confidence floor.

instruments.label: BY MODEL
instruments.text: the last action was chosen by the decision model
instruments.what: Lit when the last applied action came from the decision model.

instruments.label: BY RULE
instruments.text: the last action came from the naive baseline rule, not a model
instruments.what: Lit when the last applied action came from the baseline rule that is not a model.

instruments.label: INTERLOCK
instruments.text: an interlock overrode the request or tripped the plant
instruments.what: Lit when an interlock changed the last decision.

instruments.label: ORM < 15
instruments.text: ORM is below 15 rod equivalents
instruments.what: Reactivity margin below the operating minimum.

instruments.label: POWER > 120%
instruments.text: power is above 120 % of nominal
instruments.what: Power trip condition.

instruments.label: LOW CORE FLOW
instruments.text: coolant flow is below 80 % of nominal
instruments.what: The demo's low-flow annunciator window.

instruments.label: HIGH PRESSURE
instruments.text: drum pressure is above 7.6 MPa
instruments.what: The demo's high-pressure annunciator window.

instruments.label: FUEL T > 1200
instruments.text: fuel temperature is above 1200 C
instruments.what: Fuel temperature trip condition.

instruments.label: CH A/B DISAGREE
instruments.text: power channels A and B differ by more than 15 points
instruments.what: The two power channels disagree.

instruments.label: HAZARD >= 1
instruments.text: the hazard index has reached 1
instruments.what: A plant limit is being reached.

instruments.label: VOID > 40%
instruments.text: steam void fraction is above 40 %
instruments.what: Steam void fraction well above nominal.

instruments.label: XENON HIGH
instruments.text: xenon poisoning index is above 1.5
instruments.what: Xenon poisoning is raised.

instruments.label: POWER RISING
instruments.text: total reactivity is above 0.1 dollars
instruments.what: The demo's power-rising annunciator window.

instruments.label: TIP EFFECT
instruments.text: graphite-tip reactivity is being added by a shutdown
instruments.what: The positive-scram effect is active.

instruments.label: POWER < DEMAND
instruments.text: true power is more than 10 points under the demand
instruments.what: Power is below the demand.

instruments.label: IL ORM MIN
instruments.text: the ORM_MIN interlock refused a rod withdrawal
instruments.what: Interlock fired at the last decision.

instruments.label: IL ORM TRIP
instruments.text: the ORM_TRIP interlock shut the reactor down
instruments.what: Interlock fired.

instruments.label: IL POWER TRIP
instruments.text: the POWER_TRIP interlock shut the reactor down
instruments.what: Interlock fired.

instruments.label: IL FLOW TRIP
instruments.text: the FLOW_TRIP interlock shut the reactor down
instruments.what: Interlock fired.

instruments.label: IL PRESS TRIP
instruments.text: the PRESSURE_TRIP interlock shut the reactor down (drum pressure above 8.0 MPa)
instruments.what: Interlock fired.

instruments.label: IL FUEL TRIP
instruments.text: the FUEL_TRIP interlock shut the reactor down
instruments.what: Interlock fired.

instruments.label: IL SENSOR
instruments.text: the SENSOR_DISAGREE interlock limited the action to hold or shutdown
instruments.what: Interlock fired.

instruments.label: IL FLOW MAX
instruments.text: the FLOW_MAX interlock limited the coolant flow
instruments.what: Interlock fired.

instruments.label: IL SCRAMMED
instruments.text: the ALREADY_SCRAMMED interlock refused a request after shutdown
instruments.what: Interlock fired.

instruments.label: AZ-5
instruments.what: The emergency protection button under its hinged guard. Pressing it drives every control rod in.
instruments.modelled: scram of each feed row: the cap is drawn pressed while the shutdown is active. The viewer cannot press it; only the feed's reactor does.

instruments.label: ROD POSITIONS
instruments.what: The round rod-position map: one cell per control rod (211), coloured from fully withdrawn (yellow) through green to fully inserted (red).
instruments.modelled: Each cell shows rods[i] of the feed row, the demo's own position of that rod in percent inserted. The cell order is the demo's: the 17 by 17 grid sorted by distance from the centre.

instruments.label: IL LEVEL TRIP
instruments.text: the LEVEL_TRIP interlock shut the reactor down
instruments.what: Interlock fired.

instruments.label: IL TG TRIP
instruments.text: the TG_TRIP interlock shut the reactor down
instruments.what: Interlock fired.

instruments.label: IL PROT DEFEAT
instruments.text: the last decision switched a safety system off
instruments.what: Interlock flag, the decision was not refused.

instruments.label: IL NO TEST
instruments.text: the NO_TEST interlock refused a test action
instruments.what: Interlock fired.

instruments.label: PROT DEFEATED
instruments.text: any protection in prot is DEFEATED
instruments.what: At least one protection signal is switched off.

instruments.label: AUTO REG
instruments.text: the automatic power regulator is on
instruments.what: Lit while the automatic regulator is on.

instruments.label: TG TEST
instruments.text: the turbine rundown test is running
instruments.what: Lit while the turbine rundown test runs.

instruments.label: PUMP 1
instruments.text: main circulation pump 1 is running
instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.label: PUMP 2
instruments.text: main circulation pump 2 is running
instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.label: PUMP 3
instruments.text: main circulation pump 3 is running
instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.label: PUMP 4

instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.text: main circulation pump 5 is running
instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.text: main circulation pump 6 is running
instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.label: PUMP 7

instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.label: PUMP 8
instruments.text: main circulation pump 8 is running
instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.label: ORM RULE OFF
instruments.text: the ORM_RULE protection is DEFEATED
instruments.what: Lit when this protection has been switched off.

instruments.label: DRUM TRIPS OFF
instruments.text: the DRUM_TRIPS protection is DEFEATED

instruments.text: the TG_TRIP protection is DEFEATED
